about: The introitus of the formulary “10th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: When I cried to the Lord, He heard my voice from those who draw near to me; and He who is before the ages and abides forever humbled them. Cast your concern upon the Lord, and He will nourish you. Hear my prayer, O God, and do not despise my supplication; attend to me, and hear me. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. When I cried to the Lord, He heard my voice from those who draw near to me; and He who is before the ages and abides forever humbled them. Cast your concern upon the Lord, and He will nourish you.
